description.en: Diprotodon optatum has a deep wombat-like torso, high shoulders and a broad fleshy muzzle. Fur, ears and nasal soft tissue are inferred; a short trunk remains debated, and this reconstruction has no long proboscis.
description.zh: 双门齿兽 Diprotodon optatum 具有厚重的袋熊状躯干、高肩和宽厚肉质吻部。毛被、耳部及鼻部软组织为推断；短鼻的存在仍有争议，本复原不采用长鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Diprotodon optatum living reconstruction guided by Museums Victoria P12347 composite cast and AMNH19287 skull/shoulder photographs. Not an individual specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Skin, fur, ears and nasal soft tissue are inferred. A short trunk is debated, not established; this model uses a broad fleshy muzzle without a long proboscis. Composite mounts are not a single calibrated individual.
scientific_limits.zh: 皮肤、毛、耳和鼻软组织为推断。短鼻吻存在争议，并非已证实；本件使用宽厚肉质鼻吻，不做长鼻。复合骨架不代表单个校准个体。

scale.basis: Original working adult dimensions within Australian Museum approximate upper range3.8m long/1.7m shoulder. Width and precise individual proportions are artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet four-foot stance, visibly high shoulder region and large belly, head held below withers, short neck and modest tail. Separate limb negative spaces and slightly inturned feet.
shape_requirements: Retain original large wombat-like torso, high shoulders and broad nasal region together. Do not substitute a scaled modern wombat or hornless rhinoceros.
Substantial belly and deep chest transition to defined shoulders/haunches using profile lofts; avoid a featureless sphere.
Oversized blunt skull envelope and broad muzzle with a pair of forward lower incisors discreetly readable at lip, not tusks or carnivore fangs; no horns or long tapir/elephant trunk.
Sturdy weight-bearing limbs, relatively small inturned feet; no rhino hooves, giant digging claws or kangaroo hindfoot stance.
Modest inferred ears and restrained coat surface; no giant ears or ornate markings claimed as known. Keep belly above ground and all four contacts valid.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: large wombat-like torso, high shoulders and broad nasal region. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：大型袋熊状躯干、高肩与宽鼻区。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block large wombat-like torso, high shoulders and broad nasal region with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织大型袋熊状躯干、高肩与宽鼻区；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
